heading: 1 MGM RESORTS INTERNATIONAL REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL YEAR 2022 FINANCIAL AND OPERATING RESULTS
start_phrase: Las Vegas, Nevada, February 8, 2023 – MGM Resorts International (NYSE: MGM) (“MGM Resorts” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2022.
summary: Introduction to MGM Resorts International’s Q4 and full-year 2022 results announcing record Adjusted Property EBITDAR for Las Vegas Strip Resorts and Regional Operations, $2.8 billion of share buybacks in 2022 (including $352 million in Q4) and a new $2 billion repurchase authorization, the $1.1 billion cash sale of The Mirage operations, and award of a new 10-year Macau gaming concession. CEO Bill Hornbuckle cites a fifth consecutive record quarter for Las Vegas EBITDAR and a strong 2023 outlook driven by a robust U.S. events calendar, MGM China’s rapid year-to-date return to profitability, and BetMGM’s improvement. CFO Jonathan Halkyard highlights focus on free cash flow and shareholder yield, noting 4 million shares repurchased year-to-date 2023 for $164 million, 76 million in 2022, and approximately $4.7 billion since 2021, with the Board authorizing an additional $2 billion buyback.

MGM RESORTS INTERNATIONAL REPORTS FOURTH QUARTER AND 
FULL YEAR 2022 FINANCIAL AND OPERATING RESULTS  
• Record Adjusted Property EBITDAR in 4Q and full year 2022 for Las Vegas Strip Resorts and 
Regional Operations  
• Share buybacks of $2.8 billion in 2022 and $352 million  in 4Q22  
• New $2 billion share repurchase program authorized by the Board of Directors  
• Closed on the sale of the operations of The Mirage for $1.1 billion in cash  
• Awarded new 10 -year gaming concession i n Macau  
 
  
Las Vegas, Nevada, February 8, 2023 – MGM Resorts International (NYSE: MGM) (“MGM Resorts” 
or the “Company”) today reported financial results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2022.  
 
“We achieved our fifth consecutive quarter of record -breaking Las Vegas Strip Resorts Adjusted 
Property EBITDAR in the fourth quarter,” said Bill Hornbuckle, Chief Executive Officer and President 
of MGM Resorts. “What we accomplished in 2022 is nothing short of remarkable, and is a testament to 
our strategi c plan, scale, brand strength, talented team, loyalty program, and the diverse geographies and 
channels in which we operate. We believe that there is strong momentum in our business and our 2023 
outlook remains bright, driven by a robust events calendar do mestically, MGM China’s rapid year -to-
date return to profitability and BetMGM's ongoing improvement in 2023.”  
 
“We achieved exceptional results in the fourth quarter and remain optimistic in our outlook for this year. 
We are also focused on free cash flow and believe our company presents a compelling yield, especially 
when taking into account the value in our share  price for excess cash, our ownership value of MGM 
China and BetMGM,” said Jonathan Halkyard, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of MGM Resorts. 
“Our share buyback program continues to return capital to shareholders as we have already repurchased 
4 mill ion shares for $164 million  year-to-date, adding to the 76 million  shares we repurchased in 2022 
and totaling approximately $4.7 billion  since 2021. Beyond this, our Board of Directors authorized an 
additional $2 billion for share buybacks.”

title: Consolidated Results
heading: 1.1.1 Consolidated Results
start_phrase: Consolidated net revenues of $3.6 billion , an increase of 18% compared to the prior year quarter.
summary:
- MGM Resorts International reported Q4 and full-year 2022 results, highlighting record Adjusted Property EBITDAR for both Las Vegas Strip Resorts and Regional Operations in Q4 and for the full year.
- Capital allocation and transactions:
  - Share repurchases totaled $2.8 billion in 2022 ($352 million in Q4); Board authorized an additional $2 billion. Cumulative buybacks since 2021 are approximately $4.7 billion; 2023 YTD repurchases were 4 million shares for $164 million.
  - Closed the sale of The Mirage operations for $1.1 billion in cash.
  - The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas acquisition (May 2022) contributed to results; VICI and Cosmopolitan leases commenced in 2022.
  - Awarded a new 10-year Macau gaming concession.
- Management commentary:
  - CEO cited strong momentum, robust 2023 events calendar, MGM China’s rapid year-to-date return to profitability, and ongoing improvement at BetMGM.
  - CFO emphasized focus on free cash flow and shareholder returns via buybacks.
- Consolidated Q4 2022 results:
  - Net revenues: $3.6 billion, up 18% year over year, benefiting from The Cosmopolitan and improved travel/activity; partially offset by The Mirage disposition.
  - Operating loss: $2 million vs. prior-year operating income of $369 million, driven by $1.2 billion noncash amortization related to the MGM Grand Paradise gaming subconcession and $338 million higher rent expense from new leases, partially offset by a $1.1 billion gain on The Mirage sale.
  - Net income attributable to MGM Resorts: $284 million; diluted EPS $0.69.
  - Adjusted EPS: loss of $1.53.
  - Consolidated Adjusted EBITDAR: $957 million.
- Segment performance (Q4 2022):
  - Las Vegas Strip Resorts:
    - Net revenues: $2.3 billion, +27%; same-store net revenues: $1.8 billion, +11%.
    - Adjusted Property EBITDAR: $877 million, +26%; same-store: $691 million, +6%.
    - Adjusted Property EBITDAR margin: 38.2%, down 50 bps due to higher mix of lower-margin non-gaming outlets/venues.
  - Regional Operations:
    - Net revenues: $991 million, +10%.
    - Adjusted Property EBITDAR: $320 million, +3%.
    - Margin: 32.2%, down 215 bps due to mix shift and absence of prior-year $16 million hurricane insurance recoveries.
  - MGM China:
    - Net revenues: $175 million, -44%, impacted by a three-day COVID-related closure at MGM Cotai and stricter travel/entry restrictions.
    - Adjusted Property EBITDAR: loss of $55 million vs. +$5 million prior year.

About MGM Resorts International  
  
MGM Resorts International (NYSE: MGM) is an S&P 500® global gaming and entertainment company with national and 
international locations featuring best -in-class hotels and casinos, state -of-the-art meetings and conference spaces, incredible 
live and theatrical entertainment experiences, and an extensive array of restaurant, nightlife and retail offerings. MGM 
Resorts creates immersive, iconic experiences through its suite of Las Vegas -inspired brands. The MGM Resorts portfo lio 
encompasses 32 unique hotel and gaming destinations globally, including some of the most recognizable resort brands in the 
industry. The Company's 50/50 venture, BetMGM, LLC, offers sports betting and online gaming in North America through 
market -leadi ng brands, including BetMGM and partypoker, and the Company's subsidiary, LeoVegas AB, offers sports 
betting and online gaming through market -leading brands in several jurisdictions throughout Europe. The Company is 
currently pursuing targeted expansion in  Asia through the integrated resort opportunity in Japan. Through its “Focused on 
What Matters: Embracing Humanity and Protecting the Planet” philosophy , MGM Resorts commits to creating a more 
sustainable future, while striving to make a bigger difference in the lives of its employees, guests, and in the communities 
where it operates. The global employees of MGM Resorts are proud of their company for being recognized as one of 
FORTUNE® Magazine's World's Most Admired Companies®. For more information, please  visit us at www.mgmresorts.com . 
Please also connect with us @MGMResortsIntl on Twitter  as well as Facebook  and Instagram .
